units.source_text: 当然，会给她寄收音机的……

en.t: Of course, I would send her the radio...

units.source_text: 可是从结果来看，反而是失去的东西更多，

en.t: But judging by the outcome, there was actually more that was lost,

units.source_text: 譬如，你很喜欢的，让我冲淋洗澡的仪式再也不会有了。

en.t: for example, that ritual you liked so much, of rinsing me down and bathing me, would never happen again.

units.source_text: 哪怕牺牲洗涤衣物，你也一定会留下一点儿仅够我擦擦身体的水。

en.t: Even if it meant sacrificing the laundry, you would always leave just enough water for me to wipe my body.

units.source_text: 滚烫的水溅到我大腿间，你就像自己溅到了热水似的，

en.t: When the scalding water splashed between my thighs, you acted as if the hot water had splashed on you yourself,

units.source_text: 扭着身子呵呵地笑个不停。

en.t: twisting your body and giggling without stopping.

units.source_text: 再没有发出那笑声的机会了。

en.t: There would be no chance to hear that laugh again.
